criterion: Exactly one red ball visibly moves left to right while retaining a broadly round shape in the inspected keyframes. This narrow visual task does not score every prompt detail, flicker or overall model quality.
method: Human visual review of six-keyframe contact sheets, all three measured seeds; no real-time playback claim. WebM retains49frames; WebP may coalesce repeats.

seeds.observation: Clear left-to-right displacement of one round red ball
